significance: A Vishnu temple of about 1111 CE near the meeting of the Indravati and Narangi rivers, some four kilometres east of Chitrakote falls, built by Mumunda Devi, a queen of the Chindaka Naga line. Devanagari inscriptions at the site record a land grant to a Lokeswar by the queen-mother Gunda Mahadevi, and the Nagara superstructure shows Chalukya influence.
